name: hotel-reservation
description: React frontend and Node.js API backend

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix apps/api && npm install --prefix apps/web
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix apps/api && npm run test --prefix apps/web
scripts.test:cov: npm run test:cov --prefix apps/api && npm run test:cov --prefix apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/api && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/api && npm run lint --prefix apps/web
